title: campanula rotundifolia var. catalanica
intro: Campanula rotundifolia var. catalanica, commonly known as Bluebell of Catalonia, is a flowering plant species in the bellflower family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to calm anxiety, promote sleep, and soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Bluebell of Catalonia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
